conf.description: MOVEit Automation file activity, api-pull: REST fileactivity records shaped to ECS + moveit.automation.*, two-leg duration handling per recommendations.direct.cribl.

conf.comment: moveit-mft / automation-transfers / api-pull: MOVEit Automation file-activity records pulled from POST /api/v1/reports/fileactivity (Cribl REST Collector, checkpointed on LogStamp, predicate excludes StatusCode 5000/5010 informational rows). Records are already structured, so this pipeline does ECS shaping only. Per recommendations.direct.cribl: converts SourceDuration and DestDuration to nanoseconds (event.duration is the source leg only; DestDuration stays custom since ECS has no second duration slot for the two-legged transfer), derives event.outcome from ErrCode while retaining the numeric code, and sets event.category to the dataset's single declared category (file) since Action's own vocabulary (get/send/process/delete/internal) carries no category signal. No event.type is invented - the map gives no vocabulary for it.
